messages:
Keisha Thomas: FYI were doing an emergency minor docs update to the SDK token usage section. Small wording tweak to clarify rate limit behavior for burst tokens. Change will land as a patch (non-breaking).
Marco Ruiz: What triggered it?
Keisha Thomas: A support ticket flagged confusing wording that made one customer think burst tokens were unlimited. We added one sentence and an example showing a high-frequency short burst.
Lina Alvarez: Can we also add a short FAQ blurb?
Keisha Thomas: Yes added: "FAQ: Are burst tokens unlimited? No. Burst tokens allow short-term higher throughput but are still bounded by the account quotas. Contact support for larger committed capacity."
DocBot: PR #4328 opened with change and minor changelog note.
Sam Park: Cool, patch deployed to staging docs. Will promote to prod after quick smoke test.
Keisha Thomas: Thanks team.
